[SWS_CRYPT_20001]
⌈
The CryptoAPI provides a secure local access to
specific information. The minimal information, which shall be accessable, are the spe-
cific system name, the private key, which is associated with the caller, the name of the
CA, which is used as a trust authority, and the CA public key (or a fingerprint of the public
key where a self-certified version is available elsewhere).
